CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
For this meeting, each speaker is allowed two (2) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of one time donation per speaker is allowed (no more than 4 minutes total). Please submit a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk.

Approve the Warrants.

Annual Weed Abatement Lien List for Property Owners Who Have Not Paid for Removal of Hazardous Weeds and Authorize the Fire Prevention Bureau to Transmit List to the County of San Diego. Contact Person: Senior Deputy Fire Marshal Berberet
Approve the annual weed abatement lien list and authorize the Fire Prevention Bureau to deliver the list to the County of San Diego.
2018-06-20 Item 08B Annual Weed Abatement Lien List
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance 2018-08 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 Conflict of Interest Code. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance 2018-08 entitled, â€œAn Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 regarding Conflict of Interest filers.â€
2018-06-20 Item 08C City Conflict of Interest Code Amendments
8D.
Exclusive Negotiating Agreement to Possibly Lease Real Property with North Coast Repertory Theatre (â€œNORTH COASTâ€) to build a performing arts theatre on Lot 16 at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
City Council approves the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement to Possibly Lease Real Property with NORTH COAST.
2018-06-20 Item 08D North Coast Repertory Exclusive Negotiating Agreement

Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Encinitas and Exposure Skate for a Community Special Event. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Thill
Approve a one-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Exposure Skate to provide a major special skate event scheduled Friday, November 2 through Sunday, November 4, 2018.
2018-06-20 Item 08E Exposure Skate Memorandum Of Understanding

Design and Installation of Shade Structures at Encinitas Community Park playground, Sun Vista Park playground and Leo Mullen Sports Park playground. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Award Bid for the design and installation of shade structures at Encinitas Community Park, Sun Vista Park and Leo Mullen Sports Park to So Cal Shade Sails; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in conjunction with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as attached in the amount of $281,000 and a 10% contingency of $28,100 for additional work needed not included in the scope of work for a project total of $309,100.
2018-06-20 Item 08F Shade Structure Design and Install
8G.
Amendment to the Contract with the County of San Diego for Advanced Life Support First Responder Services in County Service Area 17. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
1) Approve Amendment 16 Contract No. 45208 with the County of San Diego Department of Purchasing and Contracting to extend Advanced Life Support First Responder Services in County Service Area 17 in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 1, in consultation with the City Attorney; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment to the Contract on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2018-06-20 Item 08G Amendment to CSA 17 Agreement between County EMS, City of Encinitas for Advanced Life Support First Responder Services
8H.
Consultant services contract for preparation of construction documents for Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A). Contact Person: Engineer II Milligan
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as attached, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with CJ Roberts Inc. in the amount of $119,700 plus 10% contingency ($11,970) for a total amount of $131,670 to provide engineering services for the annual pavement resurfacing contract.
2018-06-20 Item 08H Pavement Rehab and Overlay Consultant Contract-cm-FINAL combined
8I.
Contract for engineering construction private development inspection services. Contact Person: City Planner Sapaâ€™u
1) Award contract for engineering inspection services related to private land development projects to Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC); and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation for engineering inspection services related to private land development projects in substantial form, as attached hereto as Attachment CC-1, in an amount not to exceed $524,441 for FY18/19.
2018-06-20 Item 08I Private Development Inspection_Final
8J.
Services to Prepare North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D) for Bidding in One Phase or Multiple Phases. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Kellar
1. Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the following, in order to prepare the North Coast Highway 101 project for bidding in one phase or in multiple phases: a. Agreement in the amount of $50,000 with Tetra Tech to perform the geotechnical investigation; b. Amendment to the existing agreement with Michael Baker International (MBI) in the amount of $301,000 for work to finalize the design phase including responses to comments for California Coastal Commission (Coastal) approval; revisions and responses to comments for the North County Transit District (NCTD) agreements; 100% design of parking pods; additional design survey of NCTD right-of-way and of west side streets adjacent to the project; design and evaluation as required to meet the project conditions of approval; pre- and post-construction survey monument location and record processing; and easement acquisition survey, legal, and plats; c. Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI in the amount of $3,000 to revise the plans for the La Costa Ave. intersection to tie into the developer designed Encinitas Beach Resort signalized intersection in lieu of roundabout construction at La Costa and New Road; d. Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI in the amount of $40,000 for new construction phasing and whole corridor traffic control for building Segments A, B, C, and D at one time; and e. Other consultant agreements, as necessary, up to a total amount of $106,000, to complete final design work for the Streetscape Project for a total additional contract expenditure of up to $556,000.
2018-06-20 Item 08J Streetscape Additional Scope
8K.
Red Light Photo Enforcement Contract. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku THIS ITEM HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE AGENDA BY STAFF AND WILL BE PLACED ON A FUTURE AGENDA.
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement with Redflex Traffic Systems, Inc. (Redflex) in an amount not to exceed $580,300 for five years with the option of extending it for three more terms at the discretion of the City Manager, each term for one more year, for a total contract amount not to exceed $965,000.
2018-06-20 Item 08K Red Light Camera Contract_Final combined
8L.
Amendment to the existing contract for Citywide Street Light Maintenance and Repair Services with Clark Telecom Electric, Inc. (CTE). Contact Person: Director of Public Works Quiram
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to sign an amendment to the contract with CTE; which became effective on July 28, 2016 and was amended with additional services on March 22, 2017. This amendment would extend the current contract through FY 2019-20. The cost of this amendment is a total of $283,000 per year for a 2-year total of $566,000. Additionally, authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to sign an optional second amendment, to extend the contract through FY2021-22. The cost of the second amendment is anticipated not to exceed $291,000 per year for a 2-year period, not to exceed an additional total of $582,000.
2018-06-20 Item 08L Agenda Report for CTE Contract Amendment
8M.
Amendment to the existing agreement for Dead Animal Removal & Disposal (D&D Services). Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
City Council authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute an amendment for Dead Animal Removal & Disposal for a (1) year term, and authorize the City Manager to extend the agreement for two additional one-year optional extensions for a total agreement term not exceeding three additional years.
2018-06-20 Item 08M Staff Report Dead Animal Removal Disposal
8N.
Reauthorization of the Opening Doors Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Review the second year (FY 2017-18) of the Opening Doors Program; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center for implementation of the third year of the Opening Doors Program in the City of Encinitas in substantially final form, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney. The current Memorandum of Understanding is set to expire on June 30, 2018.
2018-06-20 Item 08N Opening Doors - City Council Agenda Report (6-20-18) COMPLETE
8O.
Consultant design and construction management services contract for Leucadia Boulevard Traffic Safety and Pedestrian Improvements Phase II (CS18B). Contact Person: Engineer II Milligan
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as attached, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with Chen Ryan Associates in the amount of $439,332 plus 10% contingency for design and construction management services for a new roundabout at Hygeia Avenue on Leucadia Boulevard and associated street improvements.
2018-06-20 Item 08O Leucadia BTSPI Phase II_Chen Ryan Contract

Approval of FY 2018-19 Operating Budget with Appropriations and Adoption of Resolution No. 2018-64; Adoption of Resolution 2018-65, Determination of the Appropriations Limit for FY 2018-19; Adoption of Resolution 2018-66, Approval of Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FY 2018-19; Adoption of Resolution 2018-67, Approval of a Policy to Pay the Current Unfunded Liabilities Annually for the Classic Tier 2 and PEPRA Pension Plans; and Adoption of Resolution No. 2018-69, Approval of Capital Improvement Program (CIP) appropriations. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-64, approving the City of Encinitas FY 2018-19 Operating Budget; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-65, determining the FY 2018-19 Appropriations Limit; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-66, approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for the City of Encinitas for FY 2018-19; 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2018- 67, approving a Policy to Pay the Current Unfunded Liabilities Annually for the Classic Tier 2 and PEPRA Pension Plans; and 5) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-69, approving CIP Appropriations.

Public Hearing to consider a series of actions to update and implement the Cityâ€™s Housing Element update, related General Plan, Specific Plan, Zoning, and Local Coastal Program amendments and the associated Environmental Assessment; Case No. 17-128 GPA/SPA/LCPA. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Open the Public Hearing and receive and consider public testimony; 2) Close the Public Hearing; 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2018-61, titled â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, repealing in its entirety the Uncertified Housing Element of the General Plan and adopting in full new text comprising the 2013-2021 Housing Element Update to the General Plan and adopting conforming and ancillary amendments to the Local Coastal Program, Land Use Element of the General Plan, and the Voterâ€™s Rights Initiative portion of the Land Use Element.â€ (Attachment 1); 4) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2018-07, titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Title 30, Zoning to provide use and development standards to implement the new General Plan Land Use Designation, making assorted changes required for consistency elsewhere in the Municipal and Zoning codes, approving Local Coastal Program Implementation Program Amendments, amending EMC Chapter 30.00 Encinitas Right to Vote Amendment to allow various changes including a change in maximum building height standards to accommodate three-story buildings on the sites designated in the General Plan and Zoning Map, and amending the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, and Encinitas Ranch Specific Plans to amend the Zone Maps in those Specific Plans and to provide use and development standards to implement the new General Plan Land Use Designation and provide for Housing Element implementation.â€ (Attachment 2); and 5) Direct staff to prepare materials and docket for Council consideration related to placing the Housing Element Update on the November 6, 2018 ballot for voter consideration.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
